correctness.rationale: The Zak formula is an absolutely convergent pair of geometric series. Exact parity decomposition yields a rational fiber with nonnegative coefficients and strictly monotone dependence on cos(4 pi omega). The lower spatial stationarity equation is a quadratic with one positive root and rigorously opposite signs at both endpoint exponentials. The upper spatial fiber is strictly convex and has equal endpoints by quasiperiodicity. Executed symbolic identities and independently summed Zak values verify critical formulas; no infinite inference relies on finite tests.

value.rationale: The naturally parameterized nonsymmetric Laplace/exponential Gabor generator has two independent decay rates, ubiquitous in exponentially localized sampling. The complete exact conditioning and sharp fiber-equality set at the smallest integer redundancy distinguish practical stable reconstruction from mere frame existence. A nontrivial quadratic shift law gives the exact worst spatial fiber and symmetry reflection; the entire two-dimensional rate space is covered, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
